title: Gastric endoscopic biopsy
text:
병리 진단 보고서

검체: Stomach, antrum, endoscopic biopsy (2 pieces)
임상 정보: 건강검진 EGD, antrum erosion.

육안 소견: 0.2 cm 크기 tan soft tissue 2개, 전량 포매.

진단:
Stomach, antrum, endoscopic biopsy:
  Chronic gastritis, mild, with focal erosion.
  - Helicobacter pylori: not identified (Giemsa stain).
  - Intestinal metaplasia: absent.
  - Dysplasia / malignancy: not identified.
teaches: Synthetic gastric biopsy: the saved reading and rules raise no tracked obligation.
